stem.en: Which method reduces the risk of infections passed through sexual contact, and also helps prevent pregnancy?

text.en: An oral pill, as it changes the release of eggs

feedback.en: A pill does nothing to stop an infection passing between two people.

text.en: A Copper-T, as it stays in the uterus for a long time

feedback.en: An IUD does nothing to stop an infection passing between two people.

text.en: Blocking the vas deferens, as sperm then cannot leave

feedback.en: Surgery stops sperm from leaving, but infections can still pass.

text.en: A condom, as it acts as a barrier

feedback.en: Correct. A condom reduces the risk of STIs and helps prevent pregnancy.

explanation.en: Pills, IUDs and surgery act on the reproductive system of one person, and they do not stop infections passing. A condom is a barrier, so it reduces the risk of STIs and also helps prevent pregnancy. No method is perfect.
